search_text: published ZDI-22-1466 ZDI-CAN-17356 TP-Link TL-WR841N ated_tp Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-10-25 CVE-2022-42433 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-42433 6.4 AV:A/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['TP-Link'] ['TL-WR841N'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR841N routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the ated_tp service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Fixed in firmware 220914. title: TP-Link TL-WR841N ated_tp Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link TL-WR841N routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the ated_tp service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
